stem: The causality behind the sudden changes was understood due to ____________ principle of Hugo de Vries.
solution: Hugo de Vries proposed the Mutation theory. According to it, sudden, large, inheritable changes (mutations) in organisms are responsible for the sudden appearance of new characters and new species. Hence the correct alternative is (B) Mutation.

chapter: Life Processes in Living Organisms Part 1
stem: After complete oxidation of a glucose molecule, ____________ number of ATP molecules are formed.
solution: Complete (aerobic) oxidation of one glucose molecule yields a net total of 38 ATP molecules (glycolysis + Krebs cycle + electron transport chain). Hence the correct alternative is (C) 38.

stem: In Maharashtra the major hydroelectric power plant is located at ____________.
solution: The Koyna (Koyana) Hydroelectric Project on the river Koyna is the largest hydroelectric power plant in Maharashtra. (Chandrapur and Parali are thermal plants; Tarapur is a nuclear plant.) Hence the correct alternative is (B) Koyana.

stem: A first state to start a separate cyber crime unit in our country is ____________.
solution: Maharashtra was the first state in India to start a separate cyber crime unit (cyber police stations) to deal with cyber crimes. Hence the correct alternative is (B) Maharashtra.

chapter: Life Processes in Living Organisms Part 2
stem: Complete the following activity by filling the box with the proper word. Asexual reproduction in unicellular organisms takes place by: Binary fission, Multiple fission and ____________.
solution: The third type is Budding. Asexual reproduction in unicellular organisms takes place by Binary fission (e.g. Amoeba), Multiple fission (e.g. Plasmodium) and Budding (e.g. yeast).

stem: Which day is observed as World Biodiversity Day?
solution: 22nd May is observed as World Biodiversity Day (International Day for Biological Diversity).

stem: Identify me, who am I? I was the first clone sheep born in Scotland.
solution: Dolly. Dolly the sheep was the first cloned mammal (clone sheep), produced by the Roslin Institute in Scotland in 1996.

stem: Write the molecular formula of acetic acid.
solution: The molecular formula of acetic acid is \(CH_3COOH\), i.e. \(C_2H_4O_2\). (Acetic acid / vinegar is produced industrially by the bacterium Acetobacter aceti during fermentation.)

stem: State whether the following statement is true or false: The chairman of National Disaster Management is Sarpanch.
solution: False. The Prime Minister of India is the ex-officio chairman of the National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), not the Sarpanch.
